description: This file defines serialization utilities, including functions for converting various data types to and from strings, handling Unicode and platform-specific conversions, and a template parser class for serialization tasks. It also includes external references to string conversion functions and constants, and defines some inline functions for serialization of primitive types.

classes.name: ParserType
classes.description: A template class for parsing and serializing text fragments, managing internal state and handling different parsing scenarios.

methods.name: ToCharacter
methods.description: Converts a character string to a TCHAR, handling Unicode and platform-specific conversions.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts various data types (string, wchar_t, char, uint8_t, int8_t, etc.) to their string representations.

methods.name: FromString
methods.description: Parses strings to convert them into specific data types (uint8_t, int8_t, uint16_t, etc.).

methods.name: ToHexString
methods.description: Converts a byte array to a hexadecimal string.

methods.name: FromHexString
methods.description: Converts a hexadecimal string back to a byte array.

methods.name: ToQuotedString
methods.description: Wraps a string with a specified quote character.
